title: AI companies leak data to advertisers [pdf]
summary: Investigative research revealing how major AI companies inadvertently expose user data to advertisers through various tracking mechanisms embedded in their platforms.
problem_solved: Exposes privacy vulnerabilities where AI company platforms leak sensitive user information to third-party advertisers
why_valuable: Highlights critical privacy concerns in AI services that millions of users rely on daily, potentially exposing confidential conversations and user data to ad networks
